scripts.predev: if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && command -v open >/dev/null 2>&1; then open -ga Docker; for _ in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; fi; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Docker must be running before starting the app.' >&2; exit 1; }; fi; if [ ! -d frontend/node_modules ]; then npm --prefix frontend install; fi
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names services,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:services: docker compose --env-file frontend/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:down: docker compose --env-file frontend/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
